paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Paragraph retrieval ratios 0.90\% of LLMs. The majority of LLMs can be classified as either conservative (ratio<300.90{%}) or open retrievers (ratio>380.90{%}).
model_annotation: This vertical bar chart illustrates the paragraph retrieval ratios for an expert baseline and twelve different large language models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the evaluated entities with labels rotated diagonally, though it lacks an overall axis label. The categories are not sorted in numerical or alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Retrieval Ratio (%)", and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50 with regular tick intervals of 10. Light gray horizontal and vertical grid lines are visible in the background. Each category is represented by a single, solid-colored bar with its exact percentage value annotated directly above it. From left to right, the categories, colors, and values are: "Expert" in dark gray (34.11), "GPT-4o" in muted teal (29.07), "GPT-4-turbo" in purplish-gray (29.16), "GPT-4o-mini" in steel blue (43.57), "Claude 3 Opus" in dusty rose (25.92), "Claude 3.5 Sonnet" in light grayish-blue (31.56), "Claude 3.5 Haiku" in brownish-pink (28.49), "Gemini 1.5 Pro" in light blue (39.37), "Llama-3.1-405B" in light purple (37.99), "Mistral Large" in beige (31.04), "DeepSeek-V3" in light gray (46.94), "Qwen-Max" in pale greenish-beige (34.84), and "GLM-4-Plus" in very light pink (43.58). The tallest bar is "DeepSeek-V3" at 46.94, while the shortest bar is "Claude 3 Opus" at 25.92. Notably, the horizontal axis label for "Expert" is visually emphasized, appearing in bold, dark red text, whereas all other category labels are in standard black text.
